messages.text: Hyung, did you see that video of you grapping my ass in front of fucking everyone?
I did. Why? You were smiling tho.
Because you squeezed my ass so hard right after you came on stage! My heart almost stopped 🙈
You were looking so pretty Anxinie. I can't hold it back.
I was so embarassed... and Xinlong kept teasing me about it!!
Tho it was heart fluttering i won't lie
You love it when i touch you in front of others don't you?
Sangwonie look what I just found in my gallery 🙈
You looked so cute with your hair so messed up
Yah Zhou Anxin... when did you take the second one? My hair was completely wild. I love that memory so much though.
Don't stay too late at the studio tonight. You've been practicing non-stop for 8 hours.
Just recording the final harmony guide. I'll be home soon.

incomingQueue.text: Baby, are you almost done at the studio? I left your favorite tea in the fridge...
I warmed up the beef ribs Noona sent 🤍 Don't push yourself too hard tonight, my Sanggeup.

messages.text: Sangwon-ah!! Did the courier box arrive today? 🎁
Yes Noona! The security guard brought it up to our dorm. Thank you so much.
Mom marinated your favorite braised galbi for three days! And I bought the most expensive red ginseng tonic for your throat.
Make SURE you give half of everything to Anxinie! He looked so slender at the airport last week, Noona worries he doesn't eat enough carbs in Korea!
Haha don't worry Noona, he already unpacked the galbi and his eyes lit up. He says thank you and sends his love.
Aww my sweet Anxinie 🥰 Tell him Noona will take both of you out for hotpot after your promotions finishes!
+++ I watched that radio show... you silly boy 💕 Be careful around the dispatch reporters! Noona is always cheering for you two.
Notice to ALD1: Tomorrow's Music Bank pre-recording call time moved to 05:30 AM at KBS Hall.
Sangwon, your custom in-ear monitors arrived from the audio technician.
Make sure everyone goes to sleep before 1 AM. No ordering late-night spicy tteokbokki!
Guys who put the tea on the top shelf of the dorm fridge?
DO NOT TOUCH IT Junseo hyung!! Anxin bought that specially for Sangwon hyung lmaooo
Yeah if you drink Sangwon's tea, Anxin will chase you with the vacuum cleaner again 💀
I heard that! Hands off the tea and Noona's beef ribs, they're for Sangwon hyung 😤
